You will need

  • 4 cups cold cooked rice
  • 3 eggs, beaten
  • 3 tbsp oil
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 1 cup peas and carrots
  • 1 cup chopped broccoli or bok choy
  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 4 green onions
  • White pepper

Method

  1. Heat a wok over high heat with 1 tbsp oil and scramble the eggs. Set aside.
  2. Add the rest of the oil, then the garlic and vegetables for 2 minutes.
  3. Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and fry 4 minutes until it starts to crisp.
  4. Add the soy, sesame oil and white pepper and toss.
  5. Fold in the egg and green onions.
Vegetable LasagnaItalian, 1 hr 40 min

Layers of spinach, ricotta, roasted vegetables and marinara.

ItalianServes 81 hr 40 min

You will need

  • 12 lasagna noodles
  • 2 zucchini and 1 red pepper, diced
  • 8 oz mushrooms, sliced
  • 5 oz spinach
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 15 oz ricotta
  • 1 egg
  • 1 cup grated Parmesan
  • 3 cups marinara
  • 1 lb mozzarella, shredded
  • Basil and nutmeg

Method

  1. Cook the noodles until just tender. Sauté the zucchini, pepper and mushrooms in the oil until browned, then wilt in the spinach.
  2. Mix the ricotta, egg, half the Parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg and salt.
  3. Heat the oven to 375°F. Spread sauce in a 9x13 dish and layer noodles, ricotta, vegetables, sauce and mozzarella three times.
  4. Top with sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, then uncover for 20 minutes.
  5. Rest 15 minutes before slicing and finish with basil.
Vegetable Pad ThaiThai, 30 min

Rice noodles wok-tossed with tofu, egg, bean sprouts and peanuts.

ThaiServes 430 min

You will need

  • 8 oz flat rice noodles
  • 14 oz extra-firm tofu, cubed and pressed
  • 3 tbsp oil
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 2 eggs
  • 3 tbsp tamarind paste
  • 3 tbsp soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tsp chile flakes
  • 2 cups bean sprouts
  • 4 green onions, cut long
  • Crushed peanuts and lime

Method

  1. Soak the noodles in hot water 8 minutes until pliable, then drain.
  2. Mix the tamarind, soy, sugar and chile.
  3. Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil until golden and set aside.
  4. Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then scramble the eggs. Add the noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes.
  5. Add the tofu, sprouts and green onions and toss 1 minute. Serve with peanuts and lime.
Wild Mushroom and Gruyère TartFrench, 50 min

Puff pastry spread with caramelized onion, mushrooms and nutty Gruyère.

FrenchServes 650 min

You will need

  • 1 sheet puff pastry
  • 1 lb mixed mushrooms, sliced
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1 onion, thinly sliced and caramelized
  • 1 clove garlic
  • 1 tsp thyme
  • 1½ cups grated Gruyère
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • Arugula and lemon to serve

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 400°F. Score a border 1 inch in from the edge of the pastry and prick the middle with a fork.
  2. Brown the mushrooms in the butter with garlic, thyme and salt until dry.
  3. Spread the caramelized onions inside the border, then the mushrooms and cheese.
  4. Brush the border with egg.
  5. Bake 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Top with dressed arugula.
Wild Mushroom StroganoffRussian, 35 min

Meaty mushrooms in paprika and sour cream sauce over egg noodles.

RussianServes 435 min

You will need

  • 1½ lb mixed mushrooms, sliced
  • 3 tbsp butter
  • 1 onion, sliced
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 tbsp flour
  • 1½ cups vegetable stock
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tsp Dijon mustard
  • ¾ cup sour cream
  • 12 oz egg noodles
  • Dill

Method

  1. Brown the mushrooms in batches in the butter over high heat. Set aside.
  2. Cook the onion 6 minutes, then the garlic and paprika.
  3. Stir in the flour, then the stock, soy and mustard. Simmer until thick.
  4. Return the mushrooms and stir in the sour cream off the boil.
  5. Serve over the cooked noodles with dill.
Wild Rice and Mushroom SoupAmerican, 1 hr 10 min

A creamy, earthy soup of wild rice, mushrooms and thyme.

AmericanServes 61 hr 10 min

You will need

  • ¾ cup wild rice
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • 1 onion, 2 carrots and 2 ribs celery, diced
  • 1 lb mushrooms, sliced
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • ¼ cup flour
  • 6 cups vegetable stock
  • 1 cup half-and-half
  • Thyme, bay leaf and a splash of dry sherry

Method

  1. Simmer the wild rice in salted water 45 minutes until it splits, and drain.
  2. Melt the butter and cook the vegetables and mushrooms 10 minutes. Add the garlic.
  3. Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock with the herbs.
  4. Simmer 20 minutes, then add the rice and half-and-half.
  5. Season, add a splash of sherry and serve with crusty bread.

Built for our family table on r3ai.dev. Season everything to taste.
